|colspan="6" align="left" style="width:50px;"| '''Notes:'''<br />
{{refbegin}}
{{note|ambassadors|1}} At the ambassadors meeting, Isabelle and Delphine agreed to cast the extra vote against Moussa.<br />
{{note|exile|2}} Due to the high amounts of evacuations and quits during the season, the castaway who received the most votes at the Day 31 Tribal Council would be exiled for 48 hours.<br />
{{note|final4|3}} At the final four, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge. Antoine came in last and was eliminated.<br />
{{note|jurytie|4}} According to the rules of ''Koh-Lanta'', if a tie occurs at the Final Tribal Council, both finalists are declared winners.
{{refend}}
